— ER (17 tables: 9 dim + 8 fact)
Green = dimension Blue = fact PK primary key FK foreign key PF part of PK and FK
PK/FK are informational only — Trino does not enforce them.
Every table also carries: etl_run_id, built_at, source_max_ingest_date.
